ValidationRule.description: QCC: When Stage has a value Recovery Type Should be only EFT Refund or Credit Card Refund
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(ISBLANK(Text(Stage__c) )) && NOT(Text(Stage__c) == 'NA') && NOT(Text(Type__c) == 'EFT Refund') && NOT(Text(Type__c) == 'Credit Card Refund') && NOT(ISBLANK(Text(Type__c))) && RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Connect'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Recovery Type can only be EFT Refund or Credit Card Refund
